spans.title: Important note
spans.text: Use `#define` mainly for include guards and conditional compilation; prefer `constexpr` for values. Function-like macros can break operator precedence and evaluate arguments multiple times; never call `DOUBLE_BAD(i++)`. `F`, `PROGMEM`, and `IRAM_ATTR` follow board- and library-specific rules.
